prompt:
You are writing production code for "KhetCast", an open-source field-action agent for India's small farmers (Code for a Billion hackathon, Agriculture track). Output ONLY one complete JavaScript file, no prose, no markdown fences. File: src/engine.js — a dependency-free ES module (export statements) that runs both in the browser and in Node 20 (node:test). Pure functions only, no fetch, no DOM.

INPUT: normalized hourly rows (local time, Asia/Kolkata), array of objects:
{ t: 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:00', temp: °C, rh: %, rain: mm in that hour, pop: % or null, wind: km/h at 10 m, gust: km/h or null, et0: mm/h FAO reference ET or null, sm: volumetric soil moisture m3/m3 (3-9 cm) or null, isDay: 0/1 }

EXPORT these:

1. export const CROPS = { wheat, mustard, chickpea, potato, paddy, cotton, sugarcane, tomato } — each { id, stages: [{ id, kc }], sensitive: {...} }.
   Use FAO-56 crop coefficients. Stages ids: 'sowing','vegetative','flowering','grain_fill'/'fruiting'/'tuber' as appropriate, 'maturity'. Example wheat: sowing 0.4, vegetative (crown root/tillering) 0.75, flowering 1.15, grain_fill 1.1, maturity 0.4. mustard: 0.35,0.8,1.05,1.0,0.35. chickpea: 0.4,0.7,1.0,0.9,0.35. potato: 0.5,0.8,1.15(tuber),0.75(maturity). paddy: 1.05,1.1,1.2,1.0,0.9. cotton: 0.35,0.7,1.15,1.0(boll),0.7. sugarcane: 0.4,0.8,1.25,0.75. tomato: 0.6,0.8,1.15(fruiting),0.8.
   sensitive: { frostC: number|null (crop damaged at or below; wheat null, mustard 3, chickpea 2, potato 2, tomato 3, others null), heatC: number, heatStages: [stage ids], disease: 'yellow_rust'|'white_rust'|'late_blight'|'blast'|'bollworm'|null }.
   wheat heatC 32 in ['flowering','grain_fill'] (terminal heat); mustard 32 flowering; chickpea 32 flowering; potato 30 tuber; paddy 35 flowering; cotton 38 flowering; sugarcane 40 []; tomato 35 flowering/fruiting.
   Wheat disease yellow_rust, mustard white_rust, potato late_blight, paddy blast, tomato late_blight, others null.

2. export function groupByDay(rows) -> [{ date:'YYYY-MM-DD', rows:[...] }] in order.

3. export function daySummary(day) -> { date, tmin, tmax, tmean, rain (sum), popMax, windMax, gustMax, et0 (sum; if all null, estimate with Hargreaves: 0.0023*(tmean+17.8)*sqrt(max(tmax-tmin,0))*Ra where Ra=12 mm/day constant approximation for India in winter; document it), rhHours90 (count rh>=90), rhHours85 }.

4. export function sprayWindows(rows, opts={}) — find spray windows. An hour h is GOOD when ALL: isDay===1; 3 <= wind <= 15; (gust==null || gust < 25); rain at h < 0.1; total rain over hours h..h+5 < 0.5 mm; max pop over h..h+5 < 40 (ignore if null); 10 <= temp <= 30; rh >= 40. CAUTION (usable but not ideal) when instead: wind between 1.5 and 3 (inversion/drift risk) or 15 < wind <= 19, or 30 < temp <= 32, or 30 <= rh < 40, with every rain/pop rule still satisfied. Everything else is BAD; give a reason code for the first failed rule among: 'night','rain_now','rain_soon','wind_high','wind_calm','hot','cold','dry_air'.
   Return per day: [{ date, windows: [{ start:'HH:00', end:'HH:00' (exclusive end hour), hours, level:'go'|'caution', score }], best: window|null, blockers: { reasonCode: count of daylight hours } }]. Windows are runs of consecutive GOOD (level go) or GOOD+CAUTION (level caution if any caution hour) hours of length >= 2. Score = hours*10 - cautionHours*5 - meanWind. best = highest score, preferring 'go'.

5. export function irrigationAdvice(rows, cropId, stageId, opts={ soil:'loam' }) — FAO-56 style checkbook for next 72 h and 7 days.
   SOILS = { sandy:{fc:0.17,wp:0.07}, loam:{fc:0.30,wp:0.13}, clay:{fc:0.38,wp:0.22} } (export it). Root zone 0.6 m (paddy 0.3). TAW = (fc-wp)*1000*rootDepth mm. p = 0.5 (paddy 0.2). RAW = p*TAW.
   Current depletion from first non-null sm: Dr = max(0,(fc - sm))*1000*rootDepth; if sm null use opts.lastIrrigationDays (default 10) * mean daily ETc as Dr estimate, flag 'estimated'.
   ETc daily = et0_day*kc. Effective rain = 0.8*rain when rain>=5mm per day else 0.
   rain72 = rain sum first 72 rows. etc7 = 7-day ETc sum.
   Decision (first match): paddy: if rain72 >= 20 -> 'hold_rain', else if sm!=null && sm < fc-0.02 -> 'irrigate' (keep 5 cm standing water advice) else 'ok'.
   others: rain72 >= 15 -> 'hold_rain'; Dr >= RAW -> 'irrigate'; Dr + (ETc next 3 days) - effRain3 >= RAW -> 'irrigate_soon' with day index when Dr crosses RAW; else 'ok' with daysUntil (simulate day by day up to 7, null if beyond).
   Also stage-critical: wheat 'vegetative' (CRI) or 'flowering' -> critical:true.
   Return { decision, depletionMm, rawMm, tawMm, rain72, etc7, kc, daysUntil, estimated, critical, waterSavedMm (if hold_rain: a typical 50 mm irrigation depth avoided, 75 for paddy) }.

6. export function hazards(rows, cropId, stageId) -> array of { date, type, level:'caution'|'stop', value, threshold }:
   - frost: tmin <= sensitive.frostC (stop) or <= frostC+2 (caution) when frostC != null. Also for any crop tmin <= 0 -> stop.
   - heat: tmax >= heatC (stop) or >= heatC-2 (caution) when stage in heatStages.
   - heavy_rain: daily rain >= 64.5 (IMD heavy) stop; >= 35 caution.
   - strong_wind: gustMax >= 50 stop; >= 40 caution.
   - disease (risk indicators, not diagnoses):
     late_blight: Hutton/Smith period — two consecutive days each with tmin >= 10 and >= 6 hours rh>=90 (relaxed Hutton criteria) -> stop on second day; one such day -> caution.
     yellow_rust: day with tmean between 10 and 20 and rhHours85 >= 8 -> caution; two consecutive such days -> stop.
     white_rust: tmean 10-20 and rhHours90 >= 6 -> caution; two consecutive -> stop.
     blast: tmin between 20 and 26 and rhHours90 >= 10 -> caution; two consecutive -> stop.
     bollworm: null rule (return nothing).
   Days in input order, each hazard at most once per day per type.

7. export function sowingAdvice(rows, cropId) — only for wheat, mustard, chickpea, potato (others return null). Ideal mean temperature ranges over next 5 days: wheat 16-22 (too warm >25 -> 'wait'), mustard 18-25 (>28 wait), chickpea 18-26, potato 15-25. Also block if rain in next 48h >= 20 (waterlogging). Return { verdict: 'sow'|'wait'|'late'?, tmean5, reason }. Use 'sow' if within range, 'wait' if too warm or heavy rain, 'cold' if below range.

8. export function fertilizerAdvice(rows) -> { verdict: 'go'|'hold', reason } — hold urea top-dressing if rain next 48h >= 20 mm (runoff/leaching) else go (advise irrigating lightly after urea if no rain).

9. export function plan(rows, { crop, stage, soil='loam', lastIrrigationDays } ) — the agent's decision function. Returns
   { crop, stage, generatedFrom: rows[0].t, days: [ { date, summary: daySummary, spray: day entry from sprayWindows, hazards: [...] } ], irrigation, sowing, fertilizer, today: { headline action list ordered by severity: hazards 'stop' first, then irrigation decision, then spray best window }, trace: [ { step, detail } ] }
   trace records each reasoning step in English, e.g. {step:'observe', detail:'168 hourly rows, 7 days, rain total 12.3 mm'}, {step:'rule', detail:'spray: 41 good hours across 7 days; day 1 best 09:00-13:00'}, {step:'decide', detail:'irrigation: hold_rain (rain72 18.0 mm >= 15)'}.
   Throw Error('no data') on empty rows. Ignore rows whose date is before the first full day? No: use all rows as given.

Write clean, well-commented code (top-of-file comment block explaining every threshold and its agronomic source in one line each: FAO-56 Irrigation & Drainage Paper 56 for Kc/TAW/RAW, IMD rainfall categories, Hutton criteria for late blight, label all disease thresholds as risk indicators). Round numbers to 1 decimal in outputs. Do not use any library.

Write src/i18n.js for "KhetCast", a field-action agent for Indian small farmers. Output ONLY raw JavaScript (ES module, no fences, no prose). No dependencies. Must run in browser and Node 20.

Languages: 'en' (English) and 'hi' (Hindi, Devanagari, simple village-level Hindi a farmer in UP/Haryana/MP understands; use common words like छिड़काव (spray), सिंचाई (irrigation), पाला (frost), बारिश (rain), हवा (wind), बुवाई (sowing), यूरिया (urea), फसल (crop), खेत (field)). Write natural sentences, not word-by-word translations. Numbers stay as Western digits. Times as "07:00".

EXPORT:
1. export const LANGS = ['en','hi'];
2. export const UI = { en: {...}, hi: {...} } with keys: title ('KhetCast'), tagline ('Your field's weather, turned into today's work' / Hindi equivalent), place ('Village / town'), placeHint ('e.g. Karnal, Nashik, Bardhaman'), useGps ('Use my location'), crop ('Crop'), stage ('Crop stage'), soil ('Soil'), lastIrrigation ('Days since last irrigation'), planBtn ('Plan my week'), today ('Today'), week ('Next 7 days'), why ('Why'), speak ('Read aloud'), share ('Share on WhatsApp'), copy ('Copy'), copied ('Copied'), trace ('How the agent decided'), ask ('Ask a question'), askHint ('e.g. Can I spray tomorrow? / कल छिड़काव कर सकते हैं?'), offline ('Offline: showing your last saved plan'), source ('Forecast'), disclaimer ('Advisory only. Disease alerts are weather-based risk indicators; confirm with your KVK or agriculture officer before spraying.'), loading ('Reading the forecast…'), noPlace ('Place not found'), sprayCol ('Spray window'), rainCol ('Rain'), tempCol ('Min / Max'), windCol ('Max wind'), alertsCol ('Alerts'), none ('—'), dataError ('Could not load the forecast. Check your connection and try again.').
3. export const CROP_NAMES = { en:{wheat,mustard,chickpea,potato,paddy,cotton,sugarcane,tomato}, hi:{गेहूं, सरसों, चना, आलू, धान, कपास, गन्ना, टमाटर} }
4. export const STAGE_NAMES = { en:{sowing:'Sowing',vegetative:'Growing (tillering / vegetative)',flowering:'Flowering',grain_fill:'Grain filling',fruiting:'Fruiting',tuber:'Tuber bulking',boll:'Boll formation',maturity:'Maturity / harvest'}, hi:{...} }
5. export const SOIL_NAMES = { en:{sandy:'Sandy',loam:'Loam (domat)',clay:'Clay (heavy)'}, hi:{sandy:'रेतीली',loam:'दोमट',clay:'चिकनी (भारी)'} }
6. export function fmtDate(dateStr, lang) -> short weekday + day, e.g. 'Mon 3 Nov' / 'सोम 3 नव॰' (implement with fixed arrays, not Intl, so output is deterministic; dateStr is 'YYYY-MM-DD', compute weekday with Date.UTC).
7. export function actionText(action, lang) -> { title, why } strings. action objects (exact shapes):
   - { kind:'hazard', type:'frost'|'heat'|'heavy_rain'|'strong_wind'|'late_blight'|'yellow_rust'|'white_rust'|'blast', level:'stop'|'caution', date, value, threshold }
       titles e.g. frost: 'Frost risk on {date}: min {value}°C' ; why: 'Your crop is damaged near {threshold}°C. Give a light irrigation the evening before and avoid spraying that night.' (Hindi: पाला ... हल्की सिंचाई शाम को करें)
       heat: 'Heat stress on {date}: max {value}°C' why: 'At this stage heat above {threshold}°C shrivels grain. Keep soil moist; irrigate lightly in the evening.'
       heavy_rain: 'Heavy rain on {date}: {value} mm' why: 'Clear field drains now. Do not spray, irrigate or apply urea before it.'
       strong_wind: 'Strong gusts on {date}: {value} km/h' why: 'Tall crop may lodge. Avoid irrigating just before; do not spray.'
       late_blight: 'Late blight weather on {date}' why: 'Cool, very humid hours ({value} h at 90%+ humidity) favour late blight. Inspect leaves; if your KVK advises, use a protective spray in the next dry window.'
       yellow_rust: 'Yellow rust weather on {date}' why: 'Cool humid days favour yellow rust. Check leaves for yellow stripes and report to KVK.'
       white_rust: 'White rust weather on {date}' why similar for mustard.
       blast: 'Blast weather on {date}' why: warm humid nights favour blast; avoid extra urea, inspect leaves.
       Prefix title with '⚠️ ' when level==='stop' and '⚡ ' when caution? No emojis: instead return also no prefix; the UI shows colour.
   - { kind:'irrigation', type:'irrigate'|'irrigate_soon'|'hold_rain'|'ok', depletionMm, rawMm, rain72, etc7, daysUntil, critical, waterSavedMm, estimated }
       irrigate: title 'Irrigate now' why: 'Root zone has lost about {depletionMm} mm of water (limit {rawMm} mm) and little rain is coming.' + (critical? ' This is a critical stage — do not skip it.')
       irrigate_soon: 'Irrigation due in about {daysUntil} day(s)'; why: 'Crop will use about {etc7} mm this week; soil reaches its limit in {daysUntil} day(s).'
       hold_rain: 'Hold irrigation — rain is coming'; why: '{rain72} mm of rain expected in the next 3 days. Skipping saves about {waterSavedMm} mm of water and a pump run.'
       ok: 'No irrigation needed now'; why: 'Soil moisture is enough for now; crop will use about {etc7} mm this week.'
   - { kind:'spray', type:'window', level:'go'|'caution', date, start, end, hours, meanWind }
       title 'Spray today {start}–{end}' why: 'Wind about {meanWind} km/h, no rain for 6 hours after spraying.' + (caution ? ' Conditions are borderline (light wind / warm / dry air); prefer the earlier hours.')
   - { kind:'spray', type:'no_window', level:'stop', date, reason:'night'|'rain_now'|'rain_soon'|'wind_high'|'wind_calm'|'hot'|'cold'|'dry_air', next: null | { date, start, end } }
       title 'Do not spray today' why by reason (rain_soon: 'Rain is expected within 6 hours — it would wash the spray off.' wind_high: 'Wind is too strong — spray will drift.' etc.) + (next ? ' Next good window: {fmtDate(next.date)} {next.start}–{next.end}.' : ' No good window in the next days.')
   - { kind:'fertilizer', type:'go'|'hold' } go: title 'OK to top-dress urea' why 'No heavy rain in the next 2 days. Irrigate lightly after if the soil is dry.' hold: 'Hold urea' why 'Heavy rain within 2 days would wash it away.'
   - { kind:'sowing', type:'sow'|'marginal'|'wait'|'cold', tmean5, reason } sow: 'Good days to sow' why 'Average temperature over 5 days {tmean5}°C is in the right range.'; marginal: 'You can sow, but it is warm' why '{tmean5}°C average; choose a heat-tolerant variety and ensure first irrigation on time.'; wait: reason too_warm -> 'Wait to sow — too warm' / heavy_rain -> 'Wait to sow — heavy rain due'; cold: 'Too cold for good germination'.
   Use {date} formatted with fmtDate.
8. export function blockerText(reason, lang) short phrase e.g. 'rain soon' / 'बारिश आने वाली'.
9. export function shareText(plan, placeName, lang) -> plain text WhatsApp message: header line '🌾 KhetCast — {placeName}, {crop name} ({stage name})', then today's actions as bullet lines '• title — why' (max 4), then '7-day spray windows:' lines per day 'Mon 3 Nov: 07:00–11:00' or '—', then footer 'Free & open source: https://cryptocloud786.github.io/khetcast/'. plan has: crop, stage, actions (array as above), days: [{date, spray:{best:{start,end}|null}}].
10. export function speechText(plan, placeName, lang) -> short spoken summary (top 3 actions: title then why) without symbols.

Keep the file under 400 lines. Hindi must be correct and natural.

Write src/ask.js for KhetCast (field-action agent for Indian farmers). Output ONLY raw JavaScript ES module code, no fences, no prose. No dependencies; runs in browser and Node 20.

It answers a farmer's free-text question from an already computed plan, in English, Hindi (Devanagari) or Hinglish (Hindi in Latin script). It must never invent numbers: every number comes from the plan.

Imports: import { actionText, fmtDate, blockerText } from './i18n.js';

EXPORT:
1. export function parseQuestion(text) -> { intent, dayOffset, lang }
   - lang: 'hi' if text contains Devanagari characters (U+0900–U+097F) or Hinglish words (kal, aaj, parso, kya, kab, karu, karun, sakta, chhidkav, chidkav, paani, pani, sinchai, barish, baarish, pala, buvai, bowai, khad, yuria), else 'en'.
   - intent (first match wins, check lower-cased text):
     'spray'  : spray, spraying, pesticide, dawai, dawa, chhidkav, chidkav, छिड़काव, छिडकाव, स्प्रे, दवा
     'irrigate': irrigat, water the, watering, paani, pani, sinchai, सिंचाई, पानी
     'urea'   : urea, fertili, khad, yuria, यूरिया, खाद
     'frost'  : frost, cold, pala, thand, पाला, ठंड
     'rain'   : rain, barish, baarish, बारिश, बरसात, mausam
     'sow'    : sow, sowing, buvai, bowai, बुवाई, बोना, बोनी
     'heat'   : heat, hot, garmi, गर्मी, लू
     otherwise 'summary'
   - dayOffset: 0 for today/aaj/आज, 1 for tomorrow/kal/कल, 2 for 'day after'/parso/परसों; weekday names in English (monday..sunday, mon..sun) and Hindi (सोमवार/सोम, मंगलवार/मंगल, बुधवार/बुध, गुरुवार/गुरु, शुक्रवार/शुक्र, शनिवार/शनि, रविवार/रवि) -> return { weekday: 0-6 (0=Sunday) } via a separate field `weekday` and dayOffset null. Default dayOffset 0 when nothing found. Note: in Hindi 'कल' is ambiguous; treat as tomorrow.

2. export function answer(plan, text, langOverride) -> { lang, intent, date, text }
   plan shape: { crop, stage, days: [{ date:'YYYY-MM-DD', summary:{tmin,tmax,rain,popMax,windMax,gustMax}, spray:{ best:{start,end,level,meanWind}|null, blockers:{reason:count} }, hazards:[{type,level,value,threshold,date}] }], irrigation:{decision,...}, fertilizer:{verdict}, sowing:{verdict,tmean5,reason}|null, actions:[...] }
   - resolve target day: dayOffset index into plan.days (clamp to last); if weekday given, first day in plan.days whose UTC weekday (from Date.UTC of the date) matches.
   - lang = langOverride || parsed lang.
   - spray: if day.spray.best -> en: "Yes — on {fmtDate} spray between {start} and {end} (wind about {meanWind} km/h, no rain for 6 hours after)." + caution note if level==='caution'. hi equivalent. If no best: "Better not on {fmtDate}: {blockerText(top blocker)}." and suggest the next day in plan.days after it with a best window: " Next good window: {fmtDate} {start}–{end}."
   - irrigate: use actionText({kind:'irrigation', type: plan.irrigation.decision, ...plan.irrigation}, lang) and return `${title}. ${why}` (irrigation is a whole-week decision; mention day's rain: " Rain on {fmtDate}: {rain} mm.").
   - urea: if day rain + next day rain >= 20 -> hold message, else go message with the day's rain number.
   - frost: day.summary.tmin; if a frost hazard exists that day use actionText for it; else "No frost expected on {date}: lowest {tmin}°C." (hi too)
   - rain: "{date}: {rain} mm rain expected, chance up to {popMax}%." (popMax may be null -> omit chance)
   - sow: if plan.sowing -> actionText({kind:'sowing', type: plan.sowing.verdict, ...plan.sowing}); else "Sowing advice is shown when you choose the Sowing stage." (hi too)
   - heat: day.summary.tmax with heat hazard text if present.
   - summary: top 2 plan.actions via actionText joined.
   Return text as a single string.

Keep it under 220 lines, well commented.
